星使StarEnvoy

BOSS job filtering assistant

Source available

Filter BOSS job listings by location, keywords, salary and experience, and review results and contact history in one place.

Save collection filters, open job pages and read full descriptions. Browser sign-in state and contact history stay local. Users explicitly enable automatic contact in collection settings.

Python · PySide6DrissionPage · uv

Current status: Working source code is available without a standalone installer. Sign in and complete any verification yourself in the browser.

Features and progress

  • Four tabs for collection settings, job results, contact history and collection logs
  • Filter listings, read job details and export CSV
  • Optionally contact matching listings and record contact times and history

Platforms and distribution

Run the Python source; OS-specific installers have not been released. See the repository for environment requirements.

Start from source

These startup commands come from the repository README. Read the original documentation for dependencies and configuration.

uv sync
uv run python main.py
